_description: Known board meetings detected by /scan-boards. Updated on each run. Each meeting is keyed by '{ods_code}:{date}'. ods_code references data/trust_urls.json or data/icb_urls.json.

_entry_schema.title: optional human-readable title
_entry_schema.source_url: URL where the date was discovered
_entry_schema.papers_url: URL of the pack (populated once papers detected)
pack_files: list of file names/links found in the pack
_entry_schema.notes: anything Claude learned that's worth remembering
